ports.scope: Actual thickened 2.60 mm cable-side mask (0.80/0.90/0.40 mm pocket walls), unified USB-A/audio T-pocket, recessed Ø5.00 audio collar passage, and photographed board reference. Positive computed clearance excludes printer/board tolerances. FDM and cold assembly remain physical gates.

power.hardware: No power screws. Release both leads and disconnect before removal.

metal_ear_conditional.physical_status: Only tab presence is visible; accessible metal height above solder is ASSUMED. No positive withdrawal reaction for a smooth tabless shell.

local_PD_reliefs.load_path: Insertion: metal back into shoe. Withdrawal: two conditional metal ears. Both directions also meet a broad plastic sled pillar/closed-lid stops. The blind relief is a cosmetic clearance and is not designed as the cable thrust stop.

power.service: With lid open, hold both upper corners of the installed panel on their rear datum. Sled enters level with both modules installed from outside, 2.10 mm forward; feed at Z+0.27, seat and fit lid; reverse to remove. Mac and screws can stay.

board-install.scope: Panel first and held against the rear datums. Align the ports before tightening the screws.

mount.scope: Rigid small-angle geometry, extreme local field excursions conservatively included in connector and service checks. Print error, flex/warp, force and actual clearance unmeasured.
